_doc: Manifest for gate 97 (lint-skill-verdict-carrier-completeness.py). Declares, per verdict-bearing skill, the REQUIRED verdict-recording field token set, its legitimate per-verdict-type exception, and a carrier-signal regex that identifies requirement-stating units. Origin: PR #1926 (P-1.56) cost 4 QA rounds because a required field was applied carrier-by-carrier; this gate mechanizes the carrier-completeness check. Enroll ONLY proven-out fields (each addition gated on a zero-finding census). Adopters of the bare guardrails pack do not inherit this project-side gate, by design.

skills.name: claim-fit
skills.carrier_signal: (?i)(every (?:fit )?(?:verdict|judgement)|recording a verdict|reject any|report back:|surface confirmed findings)
